discovery: The holographic principle and its realization in gauge/gravity (AdS/CFT) duality

nominees.name: Juan Maldacena
nominees.affiliation: Institute for Advanced Study, Princeton, USA

subfield: Theoretical physics: quantum gravity and quantum field theory
motivation: Starting from the puzzle of black hole entropy and information loss, 't Hooft and Susskind proposed that the degrees of freedom of a gravitating region are encoded on its boundary, with at most one bit per Planck area. Maldacena's 1997 discovery that string theory in anti-de Sitter space is exactly equivalent to a conformal gauge theory on its boundary gave this principle a precise, computable form. The duality showed that black hole evaporation can be unitary, and it has since given concrete tools for strongly coupled systems: the quark-gluon plasma viscosity bound, quantum critical matter, and quantum chaos. Holography, entanglement and the recent Page-curve computations have changed how physicists frame the relation between spacetime and quantum information. Few theoretical ideas of the past fifty years have reorganized a foundational question so thoroughly or reached so widely across physics.
